caseName: Jacoby v. Supreme Court of New Jersey
caseNameFull: Jacoby & Meyers v. Supreme Court of New Jersey
judges: Appeal, Consideration, Jurisdiction, Set, Took, White, Would

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. N. J. dismissed for want of substantial federal question.

Justice White and Justice Blackmun would note probable jurisdiction and set case for oral argument. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this appeal.
